verdict.rationale: The evidence shows two firm-run founder initiatives. VentureCrush is a long-running events and networks program created by the firm's ECVC group to connect tech founders with VC, growth equity, PE and angel investors. The Clerky partnership gives startups standardized formation workflows. Neither is a documented tie-up with an accelerator, incubator or university, so this only loosely meets the story. Missing for 10: any named accelerator, incubator or university partnership, details of how early startups get structured access through such programs, and independent corroboration.
